A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same research work and complete 47-page documents. Text extraction and rendered-page comparison, including Appendices A-F, support reliable comparison of all scientific content.

before.justification: v1 reports original computational experiments on guided image, molecule, DNA, and protein generation in Section 6 and Appendix F.

after.justification: v2 retains all original computational experiments and their reported outcomes in Section 6 and Appendix F.

M1.justification: The Discrete Guidance framework, predictor-guided and predictor-free procedures, Taylor approximation, and fixed-state extension are identical (Section 4; Appendices C-D).

E1.justification: CIFAR-10, QMugs, enhancer DNA, and protein inverse-folding/stability coverage is unchanged, including the additional cell types and proteins evaluated in Appendix F.

E2.justification: Corresponding experiments retain the same comparators, including CTDD, unguided flow models, DirFM-CG, DirFM-CFG, ProteinMPNN, and GWG-Opt. No comparison method is added or removed.

E3.justification: Section 6 and Appendix F retain identical data splits, sample counts, evaluation metrics, model configurations, guidance-temperature settings, and sampling procedures.

E4.justification: The exact-versus-Taylor guidance comparison in Figure 11, classifier diagnostics, sampling sensitivity checks, and case analyses in Appendix F are unchanged.

E5.justification: The seed-variation discussion in Appendix F.3 and one-sided t-tests with p < 0.05 in Appendix F.4 are identical. No run information or uncertainty-reporting practice changes.

E6.justification: All numerical results, plotted findings, and qualitative examples match, including the appendices. For example, Table 1 reports CTDD-DG at T = 0.5 with IS 8.91 and FID 7.86 in both versions.

T1.justification: The CTMC assumptions, guidance derivations, fixed-state derivation, and mathematical comparisons of approximations are unchanged (Sections 3-4; Appendices B-E).

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list, and Discussion retain the same claims about general CTMC guidance, efficient approximation, and utility across four application domains.

C2.justification: Interpretations and limitations concerning guidance-strength tradeoffs, low molecular validity, predictor reliance, and failures under strong guidance remain identical (Section 6; Appendix F).

D1.justification: Appendices D and F retain identical implementation listings, architectures, hyperparameters, preprocessing, hardware, and training-time disclosures. Resource links and their embedded targets also match.

R1.justification: Section 5, Appendix E, and the bibliography are identical, preserving the same cited works, prior-work comparisons, and novelty positioning.

P1.justification: v2 adds acknowledgement of ONR grant N00014-23-1-2587 and lightly rewrites the funding paragraph on page 12. The arXiv version/date stamp also changes; scientific prose and section organization remain identical.

P2.justification: All figures, tables, captions, code displays, and their placements are identical. The funding paragraph retains the same layout footprint, with only text rewrapping.

improvement.justification: The added ONR acknowledgement makes funding attribution slightly more complete, but the methods, evidence, theory, reproducibility information, and scientific presentation are unchanged throughout both PDFs. This administrative update does not meaningfully alter overall paper quality.
